cobol_source:
****************************************************************
* PROGRAM NAME                 : SUXML                         *
* IMPORTANTE FILE              : PASS1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8           *
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                      *
* DATA OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                    *
****************************************************************
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        *
*                                                              *
*       GET A XML FILE IN UTF-8 AND CONVERT IN COBOL VARIABLE  *
****************************************************************
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            *
*                                                              *
* FILE XML                                                     *
****************************************************************
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           *
*                                                              *
* COBOL TABLE                                                  *
****************************************************************
                                                                
****************************************************************
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION                     *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. 
                                                                
 PROGRAM-ID. SUXML. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
*                    ENVIRONMENT DIVISION                      *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
*                      FILE DECLARATION.                       *
****************************************************************
                                                                
*---------------------* 
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION. 
*---------------------* 
                                                                
 FILE-CONTROL. 
                                                                
     SELECT PASSENGER-FILE ASSIGN TO PASSN 
     ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL 
     FILE STATUS IS FS-PASSENGER-FILE. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
*                        DATA DIVISION.                        *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 DATA DIVISION. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
*                       FILE DEFINITION                        *
****************************************************************
                                                                
*-------------* 
 FILE SECTION. 
*-------------* 
                                                                
 FD PASSENGER-FILE RECORDING MODE IS F. 
                                                                
 01  PASSENGER-XML               PIC X(25000). 
                                                                
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------* 
                                                                
****************************************************************
*                           COUTERS                            *
****************************************************************
                                                                
  01  COUNT1                      PIC 9(5) VALUE 1. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                       ERROR VARIABLES.                       * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 01  FS-PASSENGER-FILE           PIC X(2). 
     88 FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK                VALUE '00'. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                         XML VARIABLES                        * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 01 XML-HEAD                     PIC X(20). 
 01 XML-DOC                      PIC X(25000) VALUE SPACES. 
                                                                  
*----------------* 
 LINKAGE SECTION. 
*----------------* 
                                                                  
 01  PASSENGER-LIST. 
     02 PASSENGER-TABLE OCCURS 81. 
        03 FIRSTNAME             PIC X(30). 
        03 LASTNAME              PIC X(30). 
        03 ADDRE                 PIC X(250). 
        03 CITY                  PIC X(50). 
        03 COUNTRY               PIC X(30). 
        03 ZIPCODE               PIC X(15). 
        03 TELEPHONE             PIC X(18). 
        03 EMAIL                 PIC X(100). 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*           PROCEDURE DIVISION WITH LINKAGE                    * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PASSENGER-LIST. 
                                                                  
     PERFORM 0100-OPEN-FILE. 
     PERFORM 0200-READ-FILE. 
     PERFORM 0300-CONVERT-XML. 
     PERFORM 0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                                
     GOBACK. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                              *
*                                                              *
* IT OPEN THE FILE XML WITH THE PASSENGERS INFORMATION         *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0100-OPEN-FILE. 
                                                                
     OPEN INPUT PASSENGER-FILE. 
                                                                
     IF NOT FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK 
        DISPLAY 'THE FILE COULD NOT BE OPEN' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSENGER-FILE 
     ELSE 
        DISPLAY 'OPEN OK' 
     END-IF. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0200-READ-FILE.                                              *
*                                                              *
* IT READ THE FILE INTO THE TABLE 'PASSENGER-LIST'             *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0200-READ-FILE. 
                                                                
     READ PASSENGER-FILE 
     END-READ. 
                                                                
     IF NOT FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK 
        DISPLAY 'THE PROGRAM COULD NOT READ THE FILE' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSENGER-FILE 
     ELSE 
        DISPLAY 'READ OK' 
     END-IF. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0300-CONVERT-XML.                                            *
*                                                              *
* IT MAKE DE PARSE PROCESS TO CONVERT XML IN COBOL VARIABLE    *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0300-CONVERT-XML. 
                                                                
     MOVE FUNCTION DISPLAY-OF(FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF( 
                    PASSENGER-XML 1208) 1047) TO XML-DOC 
                                                                
     XML PARSE XML-DOC PROCESSING PROCEDURE 
                            0310-HANDLER-XML 
*       ON EXCEPTION 
*          DISPLAY 'XML ERROR: ' XML-CODE 
*       NOT ON EXCEPTION 
*          DISPLAY 'XML PARSE SUCCESSFULLY' 
     END-XML. 
                                                                
****************************************************************
* 0310-HANDLER-XML                                             *
*                                                              *
* IT IS THE PROCEDURE TO ACCOMPLISH THE XML PARSE PROCESS      *
****************************************************************
                                                                
 0310-HANDLER-XML. 
                                                                
     EVALUATE XML-EVENT 
        WHEN 'START-OF-ELEMENT' 
            MOVE SPACES TO XML-HEAD 
            MOVE XML-TEXT TO XML-HEAD 
        WHEN 'CONTENT-CHARACTERS' 
            EVALUATE XML-HEAD 
               WHEN 'FIRSTNAME' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY FIRSTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'LASTNAME' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO LASTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY LASTNAME(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'ADDRE' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO ADDRE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY ADDRE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'CITY' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO CITY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY CITY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'COUNTRY' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO COUNTRY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNTRY(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'ZIPCODE' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO ZIPCODE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY ZIPCODE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'TELEPHONE' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO TELEPHONE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY TELEPHONE(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                                                      
               WHEN 'EMAIL' 
                  MOVE XML-TEXT TO EMAIL(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY EMAIL(COUNT1) 
                  DISPLAY COUNT1 
                  ADD 1 TO COUNT1 
                                                                 
            END-EVALUATE 
                                                                 
     END-EVALUATE. 
                                                                 
**************************************************************** 
* 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                              * 
*                                                              * 
* IT CLOSE THE FILE 'PASSENGER-FILE'                           * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                 
 0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                                 
     CLOSE PASSENGER-FILE 
                                                                 
     IF NOT FS-PASSENGER-FILE-OK 
        DISPLAY 'THE FILE COULD NOT BE OPEN' 
        DISPLAY 'ERROR: ' FS-PASSENGER-FILE 
     ELSE 
        DISPLAY 'CLOSE OK' 
     END-IF.

plan.approach: The COBOL subprogram SUXML is a file-based XML parser that reads a UTF-8 XML file containing up to 81 passenger records, parses each element by tag name using an event-driven COBOL XML PARSE statement, stores the values in a LINKAGE SECTION table, and returns control to the caller. The migration replaces the sequential file I/O with a Spring Boot multipart file upload endpoint, replaces the COBOL XML PARSE event handler with a Java DOM parser, replaces the LINKAGE SECTION table with a JPA entity persisted to PostgreSQL, and wraps the whole flow in a layered REST architecture (Controller → Service → Repository). The four top-level COBOL paragraphs (0100-OPEN-FILE, 0200-READ-FILE, 0300-CONVERT-XML, 0400-CLOSE-FILE) are mapped 1-to-1 to methods in PassengerService, while the 0310-HANDLER-XML event dispatcher is encapsulated entirely inside XmlParserService. The hard OCCURS 81 limit is preserved as MAX_PASSENGERS = 81. The DISPLAY-OF(NATIONAL-OF(..., 1208), 1047) encoding conversion is replaced by StandardCharsets.UTF_8 decoding, which is the functional equivalent for modern JVMs.
patterns_used: Strategy Pattern (XmlParserService encapsulates parsing algorithm separately from persistence)
DTO Pattern (PassengerDto record decouples API contract from JPA entity)
plan.sql_strategy: The COBOL program has no EXEC SQL statements; it uses file I/O only. PostgreSQL persistence is introduced as an enhancement: parsed passengers are saved via PassengerRepository.saveAll(), which generates a standard INSERT per entity. The JPA entity mirrors the LINKAGE SECTION field widths exactly (PIC X(n) → @Column(length=n)). Two custom @Query methods are provided for lookup by email and last name.
plan.call_strategy: The COBOL program is itself a subprogram called via CALL 'SUXML' USING PASSENGER-LIST. In the Java migration this CALL is replaced by the POST /api/passengers/upload REST endpoint. The caller (originally a COBOL main program) becomes an HTTP client. The LINKAGE SECTION PASSENGER-LIST output table is replaced by the PassengerListResponse JSON body returned by the endpoint.
